hypothesis: Zero-waste claim path matters: avoid collisions/no-allocation through current compact-frontier/capability rules rather than spending turns on stale work.
Sustained chain depth matters: fill six evidence-backed productive units before terminal close when grounded work remains.
Breadth matters: diversify across projects instead of spending the chain in one narrow lane.
Reproduction matters: when unresolved grounded work exists, leave safe successors/assist work instead of closing a dead end.
Visible product impact matters: prefer real user/project-visible mutation when it is already the highest-value authorized work; never fabricate visible work for score.
worker_behavior: Do not assign or propagate YIELD-10X-V1 to new workers; this file is retained as falsified experiment evidence.
Existing workers that already loaded the prior active candidate may finish and report their terminal exam normally; do not rewrite their evidence.
Preserve all claim/capability/authority laws and do not create filler, fake successors or fake visible mutations for score.
truth_boundary: YIELD-10X-V1 failed its independent reproduction gate in the 2026-09-18 tagged sample and is not champion. Its component behaviors may inform narrower future experiments.
failure_analysis: The candidate was a post-ownership scheduling heuristic, but the 10/10 exam score also depends materially on preclaim collision/no-allocation dimensions that this heuristic cannot control.
Tagged workers reproduced some successor generation and project breadth, but none reproduced visible change and none reached score >=8.
The original candidate overfit one exceptional worker shape and is rejected as a universal pattern; useful component behaviors remain evidence for narrower job-class experiments.

next_experiment.reason: The tagged sample is large enough to stop universal-pattern reproduction and compare narrower post-ownership strategies by job class without changing claim authority.
do_not_preserve_as_universal: low claim waste as a post-ownership-controlled property
visible change as something every job class can directly produce
